title: A charge-off carrying ONLY a penalty portion (zero interest and fee) skips the two zero slots and debits income-from-charge-off-penalty 11 (loan 4 L11: credits 1000.00 then 10.00, debits 1000.00 / 10.00)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the FOUR-LEG journal entry a non-fraud loan CHARGE-OFF posted under the branch with NO charge-off reason, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1 / product 2). request.charge_off_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's charge-off transaction id 11 (externalId L11, type loanTransactionType.chargeOff, fraud false): principalPortion 1000.0 -> "100000", interestPortion 0 -> "0", feeChargesPortion 0 -> "0", penaltyChargesPortion 10.0 -> "1000" minor units. request.charge_off_journal.fraud is the loan's observed fraud flag false. request.charge_off_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP1.json (loan 4, product 2) and the echo product-20-retrieve-one-response.json, whose account ids are equal: loanPortfolio 6, receivable interest/fee/penalty 10, chargeOffExpense 14, chargeOffFraudExpense 13, incomeFromChargeOffInterest 20, incomeFromChargeOffFees 11, incomeFromChargeOffPenalty 11. expect.charge_off_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the four L11 legs in id order: JE 25 CREDIT account 6 1000.00, JE 26 CREDIT account 10 10.00, JE 27 DEBIT account 14 1000.00, JE 28 DEBIT account 11 10.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a ZERO portion posts NO leg, so with interest and fee both zero only the principal and penalty slots post -- the observed receivable credit on account 10 is the penalty's 10.00 alone (NOT 143.00) and the income debit on account 11 is the penalty's 10.00, while the interest and fee income accounts (20 and the fee income slot) are ABSENT. A port that posts a zero leg for every slot, or that debits an unmapped/empty income account, moves the leg count or an amount cell. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the merge — the three receivable slots share account 10 but only the penalty is non-zero here, so a non-merging port posts the same legs; the fraud branch — this loan is NOT marked fraud; and the charge-off-reason mapping — absent from the product, and the port REFUSES it. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
